scope: Implementation acceptance for PR review; no production deployment

environment.runtime: Real production coordinator with FakeAgentRuntime for orchestration acceptance

workspaceTests.skipReason: Opt-in external database suites and pre-existing gated acceptance suites; FOR-62 database tests executed separately below

postgres.authority: Application operations use ordinary application login; verified owner login is used only for isolated fixture setup/inspection/cleanup
coverage: canonical resources, ordering, URL validation, document membership and revision-safe exact retries
native committed producers, matching, rollback, deduplicated fanout and recursion suppression
timezone schedules, cycle boundaries and catch-up
webhook authentication, payload/event identity, rotation, size/media and external-source revocation
live workspace management restrictions, guest policy and reviewer revocation
workspace-only model access and dedicated service identity without personal chats, login or membership
real coordinator completion, exact shared approval attribution and source authorization
pending cancellation callback denial, disabled cancellation, head-of-line avoidance and uncertain-run fencing
bounded issue purge, late callback fences, durable upload reservations and publication/compensation races

browser.sessions: Two independent authenticated browser contexts; ordinary member and administrator
browser.sourceIdentity: Executed the stable implementation working tree later committed as sourceCommit; harness stdout records the then-current baseCommit. No product source changed between these browser runs and sourceCommit.

workerCli.note: Root Turbo entry point verified enabled; app entry point also verified with product gate disabled. Real fixture execution is covered by the native suite.

releaseBoundaries: Production migrations, application deployment, dedicated worker hosting and gated live-provider acceptance remain release operations.
Both product gates remain off by default in production.
Slack, GitHub, external MCP connectors and native models absent from Forge remain unavailable.
Execution uses existing registered Forge capabilities; this change does not introduce undeclared issue/project/document tool adapters.
Packaged macOS and live provider behavior are not certified by these checks.
